test_focus: Easy case: clear majority with two distinct minorities (70/20/10).

views.extend: Extend the pool hours (earlier and/or later opening).
views.shorten: Shorten the hours, mainly due to noise, cost or safety.

must_mention: Minority: keep current hours (some see it as a fair compromise / other priorities).
Minority: shorten hours, citing noise for nearby units, running costs and safety/supervision.
nuance_notes: Several 'extend' respondents suggest compromises (quiet rules after 8-9pm, summer-only extension, trial period).
